options.rationale: Team members generally cannot bind the government.

items.stem: Which TWO are proper steps in federal contract closeout?

options.text: Verifying that all deliverables and services were accepted
options.rationale: Correct: confirming completion/acceptance is part of closeout.

options.text: Ensuring final payment and records are settled and retained
options.rationale: Correct: final financial settlement and record retention are closeout steps.

options.text: Deleting the contract file immediately after final delivery
options.rationale: Records must be retained, not destroyed, at closeout.
Outstanding disputes must be resolved, not ignored.
